facts.text: On KWC's Block Plan, students take one four-credit course at a time in four sequential blocks per semester, meeting weekdays from 9 a.m. to noon with no finals week.

sources.title: Block Plan and Academic Model - Kentucky Wesleyan College
sources.quote: At Kentucky Wesleyan, each block is one four-credit course, and you complete four blocks each semester. What does a typical day look like? Class meets from 9 a.m. to noon every weekday.
